#!/bin/bash
# Mit Zwei T Party - installation script
apt update
apt install -y git ca-certificates
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS}"
if [ -n "${GIT_USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
  ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS/https:\/\//https://${GIT_USERNAME}:${GIT_ACCESS_TOKEN}@}"
fi

if [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
  echo "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch ${BRANCH}) ..."
  git clone --branch "${BRANCH}" "${ADDRESS}" .
else
  echo "Directory not empty - pulling latest changes ..."
  git pull
fi

if [ -f package.json ]; then
  npm install --omit=dev
fi
echo "Installation finished."
